 Shopee 11.11 Big Sale Visual 
 Join this year's biggest sale on Shopee Live and enjoy VIP early access from 8 November 
KUALA LUMPUR, MALAYSIA - 
 Media OutReach Newswire - 2 November 2026 - Get ready to tune in, shop, and score big at this year's biggest sale! From now until 12 November, 
 Shopee's 11.11 Big Sale is bringing the excitement straight to Shopee Live. Catch all the action in real time with 
 star-studded daily livestreams featuring iconic Malaysian personalities, alongside 
 RM11 Million in Vouchers up for grabs, plus more   exclusive livestream vouchers  to unlock unbeatable year-end savings! 
 Shopee Live Turns Up the Heat This 11.11 
Guess what? Shopee's official livestream channel is serving up daily livestreams with fan-favourite stars and exclusive savings from 
 now until 11 November! 
Here's a sneak peek at what's in store: 
 - [8PM - 10PM, 10 Nov] Dato' Sri Aliff Syukri Exclusive Product Launch: The Malaysian celebrity is launching his brand-new prayerwear and bag exclusively on Shopee Live. Tune in and buy the new release together with a 10-item set box worth RM129, available for a limited time only! 
 - [8PM - 10PM , 10 Nov] Ruyuan & Jo Share Their Favourite Finds: Get ready to discover Picksbyquahs' handpicked favourites across beauty, lifestyle, and home essentials! Join Ruyuan & Jo as they unveil their favourite picks from brands including Cuckoo, FAN BEAUTY, Jisulife, Iconic, Kiehl's, and Lancôme, alongside exciting livestream-exclusive deals not to be missed! 
 - [3.30PM - 9PM, 11 Nov] Khairul Aming Takes Shopping Offshore: Catch Khairul Aming's first-ever livestream from a yacht! 
And that's not all! Catch 
 Ain Ramli and Shabina live as they dish out irresistible promos from 
 La Roche Posay , 
 Medicube, and 
 Torriden on 2 and 
 3 November. 
The excitement doesn't stop there! From 
 today until 11 November, Malaysians can also look forward to 
 60% Off daily livestream vouchers to save more on their livestream orders. To make things even more special, shop during the Shopee Mamak Lagi Murah Show from 2-6 November for a chance to win giveaway vouchers worth up to RM1,111. 
With exclusive deals, exciting personalities, and rewards worth tuning in for, Shopee Live is the place to be this 11.11. 
 11.11 Upgrades Shopee VIP Perks and Rewards 
Beyond live shopping, Shopee is upgrading its VIP deals for its biggest sale yet, giving more rewards to its loyal users such as: 
 - Daily 30% Off vouchers: Claim daily savings and enjoy more for less 
 - RM1 Food Deals: Get selected products from Mixue, McDonald's, and Pizza Hut for Shopee's 
 newly launched RM1 Food Deals. 
 - Early Access to Exclusive Discounts: Get first dibs to the biggest deals as early from 8 November and enjoy exclusive Knockout Vouchers and Knockout Deals. 
 - Free Shipping Discounts: Skip the delivery fees and save more on every checkout. 
 Don't let these sweet deals pass by! 
 Sign up for Shopee VIP today and enjoy a one-month free trial as a first-time subscriber to unlock all these rewards and more! 
 Enjoy 1-Hour Delivery with Shopee Buy Today, Get Today! 
No time to stock up on groceries or household essentials? 
 Shopee's Buy Today, Get Today has Malaysians covered. With 
 Instant Delivery , users residing in 
 Klang Valley c an now get all their last-minute needs in as quick as 
 one hour! Starting 10 November, shoppers can also enjoy 50% off delivery fees from 10-11 November , alongside a whole sandwich loaf on Instant Mart for just 
 11 cents , available until 20 November. 
 Spend & Win with Kamatto: Win Malaysia's Iconic Sedan 
From today until 12 November , spend a minimum of RM180 with 
 Kamatto for a shot at winning Malaysia's iconic sedan - a brand-new 
 Proton Saga MC3 worth RM49,990! Visit 
 Shopee Mission , complete tasks, and rack up points to boost the chances of driving home this grand prize.
